arguments.command:
git add AGENTS.md src/docs.test.ts && git commit -q -m "docs: add AGENTS.md that points agents to the commit conventions

pi's commits in this repository followed Conventional Commits only
because the action injected a commit-msg hook. Point agents to the
conventions in CONTRIBUTING.md instead, and check AGENTS.md's links
with the other docs.

Refs #38" && git add .github/workflows/ci.yml CONTRIBUTING.md && git commit -q -m "ci: check the commits of each pull request with commitlint

The commitlint job runs commitlint.config.js over the commits between
the base and the head of the pull request. Unlike a commit-msg hook,
git commit --no-verify cannot skip it, so the rule applies to everyone,
pi included.

Refs #38" && npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD 2>&1 | grep found; npm run check >/tmp/check.log 2>&1; echo check=$?; git log --oneline -5
